The product page also says: "AT THIS TIME TIPS ARE CONSUMER INSTALLED" The product page also says: "TIPPING BLOCK INCLUDED WITH EACH ORDER" The product page also says: "The Absolute Hammer™ design has exceptionally low engraving pressure because it is designed so that the ogive of the bullet can not be engraved by the rifling. As a result these bullets will take more or faster powder than what is normally used for the weight of the bullet in order to get to pressure. This results in higher potential muzzle vel in most cartridges. This 105gr Hammer AHT™ will be a screamer!"
